intro_zh: 本課學習用 -ing 與 -ed 形容詞描述事物本身和個人感受，例如 boring 與 bored、exciting 與 excited，讓學生能正確說出心情與想法。
can_do: 能用 -ing 形容詞描述事物的特徵
能用 -ed 形容詞說出自己的感受
能閱讀簡短故事並找出其中的感受詞

sentences.en: The tennis match is exciting, and I am excited.
sentences.zh: 網球賽很令人興奮，我也很興奮。

sentences.en: Our team is polite and we cheer for each other.
sentences.zh: 我們的隊伍很有禮貌，互相加油。

sentences.en: The baseball game looks funny, but I feel a little nervous.
sentences.zh: 棒球賽看起來很有趣，但我有點緊張。

sentences.en: Playing ball in the quiet gym makes me feel shy.
sentences.zh: 在安靜的體育館裡打球讓我感到害羞。

sentences.en: I try to be careful when I throw the ball.
My hobby is art, and I like to draw pictures of sport.
sentences.zh: 我的嗜好是藝術，我喜歡畫運動的圖畫。

sentences.en: Drawing helps me relax, so I am not bored.
sentences.zh: 畫畫幫我放鬆，所以我不覺得無聊。

sentences.en: After practice, we talk about our habit of exercising and sometimes we have trouble finding the ball.
sentences.zh: 練習結束後，我們會聊運動的習慣，有時候會找不到球而感到麻煩。

sentences.en: Watching the boring game is still fun for him.
sentences.zh: 即使觀看無聊的比賽，他仍然覺得很有趣。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① -ing 與 -ed 形容詞對照表
grammar_points.explain_zh: -ing 形容詞用來形容事物本身的特性，-ed 形容詞用來形容人的感受或反應。
table: 令人興奮的 / 感到興奮
有趣的 / 感到有興趣

grammar_points.title_zh: ② 說人無聊要用 I am bored，說 I am boring 是『我很無趣』
grammar_points.explain_zh: 當想表達自己感到無聊時，用 bored；若說自己讓人覺得無聊，則用 boring。

examples.en: I am bored during the long lecture.
examples.zh: 我在長長的講座裡感到無聊。

examples.en: He is boring because he never talks.
examples.zh: 他很無趣，因為他從不說話。

lines.en: I am excited to watch it.
But the baseball practice is boring.
I feel bored when we just throw the ball.
lines.zh: 我只是投球時會感到無聊。

lines.en: Let's try something interesting after class.
lines.zh: 下課後我們來試試有趣的事吧。

lines.en: Sounds good! I will be interested.
lines.zh: 好主意！我會感到有興趣。

sentences.en: The movie is funny, and I am amused.
sentences.zh: 這部電影很有趣，我感到好笑。

sentences.en: Reading books is interesting; I am interested in stories.
sentences.zh: 看書很有趣，我對故事感到有興趣。

sentences.en: The roller coaster is exciting; I am excited to ride it.
sentences.zh: 過山車很刺激，我很期待乘坐。

sentences.en: Waiting for the bus is boring, so I am bored.
sentences.zh: 等公車很無聊，所以我感到無聊。

sentences.en: Painting pictures is fun; I am pleased when I create art.
sentences.zh: 畫畫很有趣，我創作藝術時感到開心。

sentences.en: The math test was difficult; I am nervous about the results.
sentences.zh: 數學考試很難，我對結果感到緊張。

sentences.en: Listening to music is relaxing; I am calm while I listen.
sentences.zh: 聽音樂很放鬆，我聽時感到平靜。

sentences.en: Playing soccer is tiring, but I am happy after the game.
sentences.zh: 踢足球很累，但比賽後我感到開心。

grammar: -ing 形容詞形容「事物本身」，-ed 形容詞形容「人的感受」。

mcq.q: The exercise is ______. (這項練習很麻煩。)
The game is ______ (這個遊戲很無聊。)
The lesson is ______ (這堂課很有趣。)

fill.q: They play ____ every weekend.（他們每週末都打____。）
She is a ____ on the school team.（她是校隊的____。）
Our ____ meets on Fridays.（我們的____在星期五開會。）
The movie is ____。（這部電影很有趣。）
The lecture is ____。（這堂課很無聊。）
They feel ____ before the exam.（他們考試前感到緊張。）
I ____ to read books。（我喜歡看書。）
The ball is ____ the box.（球在盒子裡。）
They are good ____ drawing.（他們畫畫很厲害。）
